disposition: Accepted as a tentative research lead with explicit uncertainties, not as a verified sales opportunity.

review_findings: The first live report over-scored product fit as buying intent. That report was rejected; instructions were corrected and the final run assigned 0 buying-signal points.
An intermediate report used inaccessible URLs and a conflicting-headcount candidate. It was rejected during citation review.

The final targeted run rechecked Baremetrics, originally discovered by the live agent, using three reviewer-checked source URLs. It is a guided rerun, not a claim that unattended research is always accurate.
The provider evidence shows searches from both research stages, but the verifier returned an unrelated indexed source. Direct review of all three final citations was therefore necessary.
The model copied verbose scoring instructions into methodology; the substantive score, sources, unknowns and export consistency were checked.
Scoring remains model-generated and requires review; prompt instructions are not a deterministic factual guarantee.
